text:
maya: Hey finance — corpcard maxed during a customer dinner in Berlin last night so I paid a hotel deposit on my personal card. Expense ID 48762. Hotel: Hotel Zur Mitte. Deposit: €150. Charge descriptor 'HOTEL ZRM'. Charge date 2025-02-18. Receipt (folio + card stmt) attached. Do I submit as normal personal-card reimbursement? Also corpcard still shows an auth hold for €450; do you need anything to clear it?
finance-bot: Thanks, Maya! Please attach the itemized folio and a photo of the payment on your personal card. Submit via Expensify/Concur and tag expense code TRVL-Q1. Policy: short-term incidental deposits are reimbursable. See: https://redwood.finance/expenses/policy#deposits
anita.finance: Got it — can you confirm the last 4 of the personal card used and whether the corpcard auth is posted or pending? Also include the folio with zero balance line.
maya: Last 4 on personal card 1123. Corpcard auth is still pending (appears as a hold). Folio attached (file: 48762_folio.pdf). I also uploaded a screenshot of my bank txn (file: maya_bank_1123.png).
liam: Are these costs within per-diem? If it's lodging deposit, it should be fine. Manager approval required for >€100 personal charges.
jen: Approved. Jen (manager) — approving personal reimbursement for €150. :white_check_mark:
sam: Finance — tagging to ask: do we need to escalate to card ops if hold not released? Could be merchant delay.
anita.finance: If the auth remains after 7 days and the corpcard balance is impacted we will contact the card provider. For this reimbursement, please submit expense with these fields:
```
Expense ID: 48762
Amount: 150 EUR
Currency: EUR
Payment method: Personal (last4 1123)
Category: Lodging - Deposit
Manager approval: Jen
Attachments: 48762_folio.pdf, maya_bank_1123.png
```
maya: Submitted just now in Expensify (receipt attached) — submission ref EXP-2025-874.
finance-bot: Reimbursement queued. Expect funds in 5-7 business days after successful review. If corpcard hold persists, we will open a card ops ticket and update this thread. :money_with_wings:
anita.finance: Thanks all — closing action: Maya to confirm once Expensify shows 'approved' status; Finance to monitor card auth and open ops ticket if not cleared by 2025-02-25.
